about: The top-level folders of each asset repository the site serves art from. lib/content/urls.ts maps a root-relative /<folder>/... path to the repository and commit of the page's release; next.config.js redirects the same paths to the deploy's pinned commit. scripts/audits/check-published-assets.mjs fails when a pinned repository's folders differ from these (originals/ and variants/ are served through /skin-originals and /skin-variants).
